title: Penguin morphology PCA
outcomes: Use the prcomp adapter to address: Which morphology measurements vary together, and which penguins have contrasting principal-component scores?
Explain one observation with linked analytical evidence and an explicit limitation
Repair and transfer the interpretation while preserving reproducibility

tasks.prompt: State why one penguin with complete morphology measurements is the unit of observation, identify each variable role, and restate the question: Which morphology measurements vary together, and which penguins have contrasting principal-component scores?
criteria: Defines the unit of observation and variable roles
Connects the data to the stated question

tasks.prompt: Predict which original variables may vary together and which observations may separate before running PCA.
tasks.criteria: Records a falsifiable expectation before inspection

tasks.prompt: Inspect centering and scaling, run PCA, and connect component scores to loadings and explained variance.
tasks.criteria: Connects visible R source to the compiled artifact

tasks.prompt: Select one observation and compare its component scores with the loading and variance evidence.
tasks.criteria: Selects an observation using a stable evidence ID

tasks.prompt: Explain the selected observation's component position, cite a component and direction, and state a PCA limitation.
Distinguish observation scores from variable loadings and verify the variance evidence before revising the claim.
tasks.criteria: Corrects the identified evidence or assumption problem

tasks.prompt: Compare a different observation on the same component and explain whether the interpretation transfers.
criteria: Keeps the interpretation within its evidence boundary

tasks.prompt: Verify the analysis source, seed, R and package versions, evidence hash, and retained-row decision before sharing the lesson.
tasks.criteria: Verifies source, seed, version, retained rows, and artifact hash

analysis_recommendations.label: Explore numeric dimensions
analysis_recommendations.reason: Safest starting point for describing observations without adding a model.
analysis_recommendations.caution: Describe patterns only; visible proximity does not establish causation.

analysis_recommendations.label: Principal component analysis
analysis_recommendations.reason: Available when the question is about summarizing shared variation across numeric variables.
analysis_recommendations.caution: PCA summarizes variance and requires score, loading, scaling, and variance evidence.

analysis_recommendations.label: Linear regression
analysis_recommendations.reason: Select a non-binary numeric outcome and at least one numeric predictor.
analysis_recommendations.caution: Check residuals, influence, independence, and uncertainty.

analysis_recommendations.label: Binary logistic regression
analysis_recommendations.reason: Select a two-level outcome and at least one numeric predictor.
analysis_recommendations.caution: Declare the modeled event, reference level, class balance, and threshold.

analysis_recommendations.label: K-means clustering
analysis_recommendations.reason: Available when the question is explicitly about tentative groups in standardized numeric data.
analysis_recommendations.caution: Scale variables, use multiple starts, and check whether conclusions change across k or seed.

context.question: Which morphology measurements vary together, and which penguins have contrasting principal-component scores?
context.unit_of_analysis: one penguin with complete morphology measurements
context.decision_context: learning to interpret multivariate variation without treating PCA as a species classifier

diagnostics.label: PC1 variance explained
diagnostics.interpretation: This is variance summarized, not outcome importance.

diagnostics.label: Components retained in evidence
diagnostics.interpretation: Interpret scores together with loadings and explained variance.

diagnostics.label: Input scaling
diagnostics.interpretation: Scaling prevents large-unit variables from dominating PCA.

diagnostics.label: Largest absolute PC1 loading
diagnostics.interpretation: The sign may reverse; interpret this variable together with the other loadings.

cautions: Component signs are arbitrary and may reverse without changing the solution.
PCA summarizes variance; it does not identify causes or latent constructs by itself.
misconceptions: A high component score is not the same as a high value on every original variable.
A loading describes a variable; a score describes an observation.
